rachel: Heads-up  after the RBAC refactor the SAST runner started returning 403s when fetching build artifacts. Repro pipeline 6382.

mike: Can you post the log snippet?

rachel: ```fetcher: download failed status=403
error: KMS Decrypt denied for key projects/infra/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/artifacts-key
file: scanner/fetch.go:114```

avana: That smells like the scanner SA lost cryptoKeyDecrypter perms in the cleanup. Check the IAM diff around 2024-07-02T01:05Z.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident created SEC-2024-2114 "sast artifact decrypt failures post-rbac". Paging @rachel @avana.

infra-bot: Audit log snapshot saved to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-2114/audit.log

mike: Short-term unblock: apply a conditional, one-hour binding for serviceAccount:scanner@infra.iam with condition `request.time < timestamp(\"2024-07-02T03:30:00Z\")`. That should let CI stabilize while we investigate.

avana: I applied a temporary grant and added the grant-id to the incident bucket. Pipeline 6382 retried and now completes.

rachel: Thanks. We exported failing job artifacts and keystore audit to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-2114/. Keeping evidence immutable.

mike: Root cause appears to be the RBAC sweep replaced `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the artifacts key with a narrower `roles/storage.viewer` for the scanner SA. The change author was infra-admin at 2024-07-02T01:05Z per audit.

avana: Remediation plan: (1) design a scoped role that allows decrypt only for the artifacts-key resource name, (2) attach condition limiting usage to the CI runner identity, (3) add a GH pre-merge check in infra repo that simulates IAM for scanner SA (run `gcloud iam roles test` or equivalent), (4) add alerting for repeated `KMS Decrypt denied` patterns in scan pipelines.

mike: I'll open GH issues: infra#3010 (scoped decrypt role), infra#3011 (iam-simulate pre-merge check), ops#3012 (scan-auth-failure alert).

avana: For the post-incident compliance note: include timestamps, the audit entry who changed the binding, the temp grant id, and the evidence bucket path. Tagging @people-ops for the PM.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-2114 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-07-05 16:00 UTC.

rachel: Also let's consider an automated smoke that runs after any keystore or RBAC PR lands: run a small SAST fetch that exercises artifact decrypts. That would catch regressions earlier.

mike: Agreed, adding to infra#3011. Closing this thread; all evidence in gs bucket. :white_check_mark:
